scripts.test:smoke: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('allure-results', { recursive: true, force: true })" && wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec ./wdio_philosophy_platform_ui/test/specs/smoke.ts && allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.test:regression: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('allure-results', { recursive: true, force: true })" && wdio run ./wdio.conf.ts --spec "./wdio_philosophy_platform_ui/test/specs/regression/**/*.ts" && allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report:open: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
